text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
The crowd is going absolutely wild
today! Clearly
they're ready to see what
will unfold on the stage
of the Japanese
Oaks this year!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Male Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Phew! Even I'm starting to feel nervous!
Break a
leg, Mejiro Dober!

text_block_list.name: Female Dober Fan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I really hope Dober can run at her
very best
today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Stop fussing over me so much.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: To be honest, yeah. But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's not so bad if I pretend I'm just
shaking with
excitement.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretending it's excitement. It feels
more
reassuring that way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer... You believe in me, right?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you believe in me?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Do you still believe in my running and
my
strength?
